translations.web: It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh; not day, and not night; but it will come to pass, that at evening time there will be light.
translations.bsb: It will be a unique day known only to the LORD, without day or night; but when evening comes, there will be light.
translations.kjv: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
translations.asv: but it shall be one day which is known unto Jehovah; not day, and not night; but it shall come to pass, that at evening time there shall be light.
